summary: The disk that make rach2-sealed-disk writes, booted by SeaBIOS on AHCI and operated over SSH alone, as it is once it is in the laptop: a fault case that walks the machine's life on one copy and a control case that injects nothing; the program is tests/cases/machine/sealed_scenario.c

cases.behavior: with nothing typed at the console, the sealed disk comes up on its ext2 root and answers a key login; a kernel sent over SSH is installed, tried once and committed; a destroyed candidate is caught by the fallback and repaired from it; a missing, a faulty and a dirty root under an armed trial each land in recovery, which repairs the root; a staged menu is shown and a torn one leaves the machine booting; the boot loader replaced through /dev/grubcore boots with the old core zeroed; and a root destroyed with the machine stopped is rewritten from recovery through an ssh pipe and boots

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the copy of the disk, which it keeps after a failure; the scenario removes its copy of the demo key and the marked kernel after a pass

steps.does: boot the declared Rach2 OpenSSH client and open its framed command channel

read the copy's GUID table, mark a copy of the kernel, boot the disk until init starts the SSH server and the server answers, and read the update process, a volume made with mke2fs, bootctl status, the command line, the mounts, the console and the lease
send the marked kernel, install it, try a commit, reboot into the trial, commit it, write it as the fallback, arm the fallback, reboot into it and power off
zero the candidate slot's first sector, boot on the fallback, install the marked kernel again, reboot, commit and power off
arm the candidate over a recovery default, zero the root's superblock, boot until the kernel says the root is missing, cut the power, boot into recovery and put the superblock back
arm the candidate, free a reached inode and clear the valid bit with debugfs, boot until the root mounts read-only, cut the power and boot into recovery
arm the candidate, repair the root with e2fsck -fp on the host and clear the valid bit, boot to the login, cut the power and boot into recovery
arm recovery, run e2fsck on the root there, arm the candidate, and boot it, check it and commit it
stage a menu, reboot to see it, truncate it on the copy and boot again
send GRUB's pinned GPT core and install it with bootctl grub, zero the old core on the copy and boot through the new one

zero the root's superblock, arm the fallback in the environment block and boot until the kernel says the root is missing, arm recovery, rewrite the root through ssh with reflash, and compare the copy's root with the disk's
restart the Rach2 client with the extracted root as its declared raw input disk
boot the rewritten root and read bootctl status, the console and the lease

assertions.checks: the copy's GUID table has a boot partition first and an ext2 root, the first partition whose superblock has 0xEF53 at byte 56
a copy of the kernel has its banner Rach2 Booting rewritten as Rach2 SEALED! by binfind, and elfcheck --kernel takes the copy
after init says it started the SSH server and the server answers, ps on the installed root shows the update process
mke2fs makes a volume in a file on the installed root that a loop device mounts, takes a file on and gives back after a remount
bootctl status at the first boot says booted: candidate
bootctl status gives the candidate slot's first sector, which the fallback step destroys
bootctl status at the first boot says next_entry: absent
the first boot's command line names the ext2 root, rach2.root=GPTID=1acef00d-0f1e-4d2c-8b3a-c0ffee000001,3 rach2.rootfstype=ext2
the mount table has /dev/disk0p3 / ext2 rw,relatime
the first boot's console has no ext2: check, since a freshly built root is clean
the first boot's console has no Falling back to
the first untouched boot has no modules: found record from the recovery RAM image
/var/log/services records a lease of an address, which init's DHCP client took
the marked kernel sent down an ssh connection to cat > /tmp/kernel arrives, ssh exiting 0
bootctl kernel /tmp/kernel says installed: into the candidate slot
bootctl commit while the trial is armed exits other than 0 and says has not booted
after the refused commit bootctl status still says saved_entry: fallback
after the refused commit bootctl status still says next_entry: candidate
the trial boot's console has Rach2 SEALED!, the installed kernel's banner
bootctl status at the trial boot says booted: candidate
bootctl commit after the trial boot says committed: the candidate is the saved default
bootctl fallback says the fallback was written from the committed candidate and read back
bootctl trial fallback says armed: the next boot tries fallback
bootctl status at the next boot says booted: fallback
that boot's console has Rach2 SEALED!, so the fallback file has the committed kernel
with the candidate slot's first sector zeroed, the boot's console has GRUB's Falling back to
bootctl status at that boot says booted: fallback
the fallback's command line names the installed ext2 root
the fallback's mount table has /dev/disk0p3 / ext2
the marked kernel sent again from the machine that fell back arrives
bootctl kernel says installed: into the candidate slot
bootctl status at the next boot says booted: candidate
bootctl commit then says committed: the candidate is the saved default
bootctl env saved_entry recovery and bootctl trial candidate leave next_entry: candidate, before the root is made missing
with the root's superblock zeroed the armed boot's kernel says root: GPTID=1acef00d-0f1e-4d2c-8b3a-c0ffee000001,3: /dev/disk0p3 has no ext2 file system this kernel mounts
that boot's whole console has no rach2 login:
bootctl status at the boot after it says booted: recovery
and next_entry: absent or empty, the trial spent
the candidate trial is armed over a recovery default before the root is made faulty
with /etc/hostname's inode freed in the bitmap and the valid bit clear, the armed boot's kernel says ext2: mounted read-only: the check found a fault
that boot's console has ext2: check: inode N: a reached inode the bitmap calls free
bootctl status at the boot after it says booted: recovery
and next_entry: absent or empty
the candidate trial is armed over a recovery default before the root is made dirty
e2fsck -fp on the host repairs the faulty root, exiting 0, 1 or 2
with the valid bit alone clear the armed boot reaches rach2 login:
that boot's console has ext2: check: clean
bootctl status at the boot after it says booted: recovery
and next_entry: absent or empty
bootctl trial recovery leaves next_entry: recovery
e2fsck -y /dev/disk0p3 in recovery exits 0 or 1
bootctl trial candidate in recovery leaves next_entry: candidate
the repaired root's boot has no ext2: check on its console
bootctl status at that boot says booted: candidate
its mount table has /dev/disk0p3 / ext2 rw,relatime
bootctl commit then says committed: the candidate is the saved default
bootctl config of a menu with the entry sealedone says staged: as a menu in a slot
the next boot's console has sealedone, the staged entry in GRUB's menu
binfind finds the staged entry's line on the copy
with the menu truncated mid-entry and its size kept, the boot's console has a loader error, in any case
and bootctl status at that boot says booted: candidate
the kernel says devfs: /dev/grubcore: BIOS boot partition 4, 2014 sectors at LBA 34
GRUB's pinned GPT core sent down an ssh connection arrives
bootctl grub says it wrote the core in the tail at LBA 1041 and the entry sector at LBA 34 now points there
with sectors 35 to 1040 zeroed on the copy, bootctl status at the next boot says booted: candidate
binfind finds GRUB's environment block on the copy
with the root's superblock zeroed and the fallback armed in the block, the kernel says the root has no ext2 file system it mounts
that boot's whole console has no rach2 login:
with recovery armed in the block, the boot's console has modules: found, the recovery entry's RAM image
recovery has /dev/disk0 as a block device
the disk's root sent through the SSH client's attached raw input disk to reflash /dev/disk0 makes reflash say it wrote the root's whole size
after a sync and a power-off the copy's root has the bytes of the disk's root, compared on the host
the last boot's console has no Falling back to
bootctl status at the last boot says booted: candidate
/var/log/services of the rewritten root records a lease

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case writes the machine's disk between boots, destroys its root and replaces its boot loader, which only a copy of the disk under QEMU allows
